svg.title: Yashvardhan Thanvi, founder of LLMSlim
svg.desc: AI engineer and open source builder from Jaipur, India. Available for freelance work.

g.text: I make tools I want to use. Sometimes that means a smaller
LLM prompt. Sometimes it means helping a farmer decide better.
